messages:
eval-bot: :warning: nightly-evals runner detected failures for model redwood-qa-v2-int4 on suites [safety_cohorts, longcontext_fewshot]
alina: seeing the alert, what's the initial severity? any owner yet?
ben: severity P2 -> impacting canary traffic. initial metric deltas: safety false-positive up, fewshot EM down ~9%. tagging eng-ml + eng-runtime. @diane can you take lead on repro?
carlos: quick paste of delta table:
```
model                | suite                 | delta
redwood-qa-v2-int4   | safety_cohorts        | +0.12 FP rate
redwood-qa-v2-int4   | longcontext_fewshot   | -9.4% EM
redwood-qa-v2-fp16    | longcontext_fewshot   | -0.4% EM
```
ben: ok that gap between int4 and fp16 is big. hypothesis: quantization config or KV-cache precision.
diane: starting repro locally. steps I'll run:
1) checkout main @commit `a3f9d2b`
2) run `./tools/nightly_eval --model redwood-qa-v2-int4 --suites safety_cohorts,longcontext_fewshot --job-id triage-179876`
3) collect `metrics.json` and `server.log`
runtime-oncall: pinging infra — did the canary rollout use new kernel set? last kernel update landed yesterday on canary nodes.
carlos: job id from nightly alert: nightly-2026-11-05-03: job logs section shows `quantize-runner v0.9.1` and `torch-kernel 2.1.3+nv`. attaching snippet in case:
```
[2026-11-05T03:12:14Z] quantize-runner: applied int4 profile 'fast-latency'
[2026-11-05T03:12:17Z] runtime: loaded kernels: aten_cuda_2.1.3_nv
```
runtime-oncall: i see potential mismatch with our int4 microkernels. I'm triaging host-level logs now. if confirmed, suggest fallback route to `redwood-qa-v2-fp16` for canary.
ben: agreed. action items:
- diane: repro + diff artifacts (owner)
- runtime-oncall: infra logs + confirm kernel mismatch (owner)
- carlos: prepare rollback plan for canary routing and canary traffic % (owner)
- me: coordinate and notify customers if escalates
alina: please update thread when repro is done. if repro reproduces, we should flip canary traffic to fp16 until fix.
diane: started run — ETA ~18m. sharing intermediate metrics if anything obvious.
ben: added :eyes: and will open a short incident doc if we hit broader regression.
alina: thanks — pinging #eng-runtime and #eng oncall too.
runtime-oncall: quick note — if you need kernel rollback, i'll need approval from infra lead, but we can patch routing first.
carlos: if repro confirms quant profile issue, we should revert quant profile only (fast-latency) and re-run quantize pipeline.
diane: repro complete, attaching top-level metrics (summary):
```
safety_cohorts: FP +0.13 (regressed)
longcontext_fewshot: EM -9.2%
```
diane: uploading artifacts to s3://redwood-evals/triage/179876/job-metrics.json
alina: ack. next: if runtime-oncall confirms kernel, we'll patch routing. otherwise, rollback quant profile. keeping P2 for now.
ben: noted. I'll start the incident doc template and link it here once created.
runtime-oncall: confirmed kernel mismatch on 3 canary hosts, filing infra ticket INF-8347.
carlos: starting rollback of canary model routing to `redwood-qa-v2-fp16` (will ramp to 100% canary within 10m). I'll post update when done.
alina: thanks all. keep updates brief in this thread. :thumbsup:
ben: update — routing rollback to fp16 completed at 1798765800. monitoring metrics from live traffic.
diane: local eval after rollback shows longcontext EM back to -0.6% vs fp16 baseline. closing repro loop for now.
alina: great work. leaving thread open until infra ticket resolved.
